purpose: Repair Phase-03 measurement confounds and perform actual executed MoE routing audit without changing KiaOmni policies or the frozen legacy budgets.

dataset.frozen_source_set: All 27 IDs from the parent Phase-03 8K-16K eligible index; official-prompt length is revalidated before GPU execution.

scoring.real_primary: parsed multiple-choice accuracy after robust deterministic answer extraction
scoring.ppl: teacher-forced perplexity of the same gold answer target for every condition

routing.source: Transformers 4.57.6 actual Qwen3MoeSparseMoeBlock gate logits from the executed forward. The runner reconstructs the exact softmax/top-k dispatch used by that block and independently hooks every expert module; per-layer/per-expert dispatched token counts must match exactly.
routing.generation_routing: Not compared after output-token divergence; primary routing audit is prompt prefill on matched retained source tokens.
routing.dispatch_verification: Exact expert-assignment counts from actual expert calls must equal counts implied by the same forward's actual gate logits for every sparse layer and expert.

performance.note: Routing/PPL teacher pass is diagnostic overhead and is reported separately from generation latency.

preflight.cases: one 512-token deterministic synthetic probe plus one real case across FullContext, both policies, and B512

claim_boundary: This remains prompt-side pruning, not runtime past_key_values eviction.
Actual routing telemetry observes executed expert dispatch but does not intervene in routing.
Performance claims must separate saliency/routing-diagnostic overhead from generation timing.
